title.narrative: START Fund - Emergency support for displaced populations and host families in Torodi

description.narrative: The displaced population urgently need support in other to survive the crisis because they had to flee their villages living behind them all their belongings. The assistance will allow people to have access to basic necessities as well as food in short term, and will prevent the spread of diseases related to the poor hygiene and lack of clean water.

The present project is intended to provide emergency support to 8 525 displaced people and 1750 people of host communities in the region of Torodi in Niger, affected by the attack of terrorists. WHH together with Help will provide assistance in terms of unconditional cash transfers, water trucking, Non Food Items and shelter kits and nutrition support. Affected population present high vulnerabilities and as market is still functioning, the response proposed aims at bringing rapid and efficient solutions to displaced populations that lost their livelihoods and sources of food due to the crisis.
